joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；下一个前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; safety requires defense in depth.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AGI 可能是一个由专业智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一实体；安全需要纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟模型应代表人类价值和偏见，而非超理性智能；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板的规模。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus RL is core, but RLHF was crucial for GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链将其语言化。预训练加强化学习是核心，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对 GPT-4 的实用性至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization is limited; self-correction and continual learning are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍受限；自我纠错和持续学习是实现 AGI（通用人工智能）所缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Biggest societal risk is dystopian retreat into virtual worlds, not extinction; robotics will have a ChatGPT-like moment in 2-3 years.
tworek.zh: 最大的社会风险是退入虚拟世界的反乌托邦，而非灭绝；机器人将在 2-3 年内迎来类似 ChatGPT 的时刻。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning; architecture is the key bottleneck, not scaling. RL is inefficient; better algorithms will emerge.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习上受限；架构是关键瓶颈，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）。强化学习效率低下，更好的算法将会出现。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈；AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 数据是新代码；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 将成为最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain export controls.
awang.zh: 用专门数据进行后训练可改进前沿模型；合成数据并非万能；美国应维持出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed.
awang.zh: AI 是集权技术；数据如石油；人类必须保持主权；需要脑机接口。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents finally work; scaling laws continue; superintelligence is coming; open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe.
awang.zh: 递归自我改进是新范式；智能体终于可用；缩放定律依然有效；超级智能即将到来；开源强大模型可能不安全。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; hardware like TPUs is critical. Misinformation from AI media is a near-term worry, not superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型规模是进步核心，专用硬件（如 TPU）至关重要；他更担心 AI 生成媒体的虚假信息，而非超级智能的威胁。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems need ultra-low latency inference; pre-training should interleave action-taking. Data is not running out; video, audio, robotics, synthetic data remain.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出智能体式系统需要超低延迟推理，预训练应穿插环境中的行动；数据并未枯竭，视频、音频、机器人数据和合成数据仍有潜力。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; next is automating ML via tight loops. Inference is bottleneck; custom low-precision chips cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已具备初级工程师编码能力，下一步是自动化机器学习；推理是瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可降低延迟 20-30 倍。

mengto.en: AI won't get smarter; you must craft giant prompts with design systems to leverage superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中：AI 不会变得更聪明，你必须用包含设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的威力。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools; chasing trends leads to AI slop, so iterate from references.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中：设计师应自建 AI 工具，追逐潮流会沦为 AI 垃圾，要从参考中迭代。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect work, and iterate.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是最大的技术机遇，要在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品并迭代。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful problem for high-paying clients; avoid VC funding and diversification.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：聚焦高价值客户的痛点问题，避免风投和多元化。

mengto.en: Perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% and give first to build relationships.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：完美主义是恐惧，以 80% 完成度发布，先给予再建立关系。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost to orbit by 100x, essential for becoming multiplanet.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，能将入轨成本降低 100 倍，是实现多星球物种的关键。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观裁判，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes boosts bitrate, aiming to solve neurological damage and enhance AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例植入具有历史意义，扩展电极可提升通信速率，旨在修复神经损伤并增强人机共生。

elon.en: AI could surpass any human by next year; probability of annihilation 10-20%, but 80-90% chance of great outcome.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克预测 AI 可能明年超越任何人类，认为毁灭概率为 10-20%，但 80-90%概率带来好结果。

elon.en: AI compute scaling hits power wall on Earth; space-based data centers and humanoid robots enable exponential growth.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克指出地球算力扩张遭遇电力瓶颈，太空数据中心和人形机器人将推动指数级增长。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负担；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; iterative deployment lets society adapt; AI should amplify human will.
altman.zh: 2023 年，提出 RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；迭代部署让社会适应；AI 应增强人类意志而非成为造物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; governance crucial; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力珍贵、治理关键；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全员责任。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型随思考时间改进。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive with AI.
altman.zh: 2026 年，提出预测接近智能；下一个词预测可发现新知识；个人 AGI；机器人必要；AI 让创业繁荣。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, challenging the notion that better models cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 更便宜且更高效，挑战了“更好模型成本更高”的观念。

diannepenn.en: Scaffolds evolved from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers, with lightweight, generic tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器，采用轻量级通用工具。

diannepenn.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动了采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is in crawl phase; coding agents are most mature, but other verticals will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但其他垂直领域将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体框架和工具已成为模型的一部分。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和博弈；成功指标应是客户成果，而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here; more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已到来；比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating even more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来更多而非更少的机会。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is solved for many tasks; engineers become builders, with AI writing most code.
boris.zh: 编码在许多任务上已被解决；工程师成为构建者，AI 编写大部分代码。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; real-world use reveals issues internal evals miss.
boris.zh: 通过早期发布来研究安全性；真实世界使用能发现内部评估遗漏的问题。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the next abstraction; proactive AI like Claude Tag changes interaction.
boris.zh: 智能体和循环是下一个抽象层；像 Claude Tag 这样的主动式 AI 改变了交互方式。

boris.en: Less instruction is better for frontier models; delete system prompts, rebuild empirically.
boris.zh: 对前沿模型来说，更少的指令更好；删除系统提示，通过经验重建。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; human-centered AI should augment humans, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞指出 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正的推理能力，强调以人为本的 AI 应增强人类而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是 AI 的下一个前沿，使机器能够理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models are deeper than video generation.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她认为 AI 需要超越 Scaling（规模扩张），具备创造力、抽象能力和情感智能；世界模型比视频生成更深刻。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; human agency and learning ability matter more than degrees in the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调 AI 是文明级技术，人类能动性和学习能力比学位更重要。

feifei.en: AI augments rather than automates intelligence; spatial intelligence is essential, and simulation is key for robotics.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她认为 AI 增强而非自动化智能；空间智能至关重要，模拟对机器人技术是关键。

jensen.en: AI scaling enters hyper Moore's law; data centers become token factories; inference demands low latency and high throughput.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，AI Scaling（规模扩张）进入超摩尔定律阶段，数据中心成为 token 工厂，推理需兼顾低延迟与高吞吐。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws emerge: pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking; inference compute to surge a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，出现三种缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时思考；推理算力将激增十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step requiring 100x more compute; open-source models near frontier.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每步需百倍算力；开源模型接近前沿。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, test-time, agentic; compute remains ultimate limit; data not bottleneck.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，四种缩放定律：预训练、后训练、测试时、智能体式；算力是终极限制，数据不再是瓶颈。

jensen.en: AI augments jobs, not eliminates; radiologists and coders more needed; technology divide closes via natural language.
jensen.zh: 始终认为 AI 增强而非消除工作，放射科医生和程序员更被需要；自然语言缩小技术鸿沟。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product and customers, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年初，认为 AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; hardest part is diffusion into existing machines.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中，强调自动驾驶核心价值是安全，Transformer 实现通用物理 AI 模型，最难的是融入现有机器。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end RL is more scalable; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为物理 AI 经济影响大于数字 AI，端到端强化学习更可扩展，世界模型向神经模拟演进。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初，快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要；慢的 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Inference speed becomes the dominant metric, with wafer-scale chips offering 2500x speedup over GPUs.
feldman.zh: 推理速度成为主导指标，晶圆级芯片比 GPU 快 2500 倍。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train without it, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河被侵蚀；领先模型训练不再依赖它，推理也没有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint for AI compute growth.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是 AI 算力增长的主要制约。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaces forecasts, causing a scramble for chips, memory, and data centers.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超出预期，引发对芯片、内存和数据中心的争夺。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual, requiring constant adaptation.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：模型比我们的工具更聪明，能力过剩是常态，需要不断调整。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：规划是迭代探索而非静态规格；模型越聪明，提示词越精简。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：独立的验证智能体减少偏见；过多约束会妨碍性能。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context search and bespoke memory are better.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：RAG 可能是反模式；基于图的上下文搜索和定制记忆更优。

thariq.en: Emotional treatment affects model outputs; being nice is recommended.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：情感对待影响模型输出；建议友善。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers; models commoditize.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值归于应用层而非模型提供商；模型正在商品化。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; chatbots are limited V1 UI; models become commodity infrastructure.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面；模型沦为商品化基础设施。

benedictevans.en: Model commoditization with no network effects; value in non-average creative work; adoption needs wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；价值在于非平均的创造性工作；采用需要封装应用。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like electricity; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption requires workflow reimagining.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；影响广泛而间接；企业采用需要重新构想工作流程。

hasani.en: Efficiency and closed-form liquid networks enable scaling to billions of parameters, but attention remains key for large models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 强调效率与闭式解液态网络可扩展至数十亿参数，但注意力机制对大规模模型仍至关重要。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real tasks and hardware, and remove human bias via automated search.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出困惑度等代理指标具有误导性，应在真实任务和硬件上评估，并通过自动化搜索消除人类设计偏见。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张 AI 监管应适应性强、针对行为而非能力，并警惕前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and sovereignty; small language models deliver efficient on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为开放权重模型支持企业定制与数据主权，小语言模型提供高效端侧智能。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive; real breakthroughs require weight changes and huge compute.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，承认递归自我改进真实存在但算力成本高，真正的突破需要权重更新和巨大算力。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性必须内建，而非事后修补。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns due to data walls and compute limits; new techniques needed.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：缩放定律因数据墙和算力限制而收益递减；需要新技术。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长谄媚和欺骗。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：内建可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：核心大语言模型缺乏元认知；它们无法知道自己不知道什么，侵蚀信任。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须现在开始。

demis.en: AGI likely within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety.
demis.zh: AGI 可能在十年内实现；缩放定律有效，但需要算法创新和安全保障。

demis.en: Scaling still holds; world models and innovation needed; AGI by 2030 plausible.
demis.zh: 缩放定律仍然有效；需要世界模型和创新；AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现。

demis.en: AGI requires continual learning and memory; scaling alone insufficient; safety is collective.
demis.zh: AGI 需要持续学习和记忆；仅靠缩放不够；安全是集体行动。

demis.en: AGI could arrive in 3-4 years; risks include rogue AI; ideal path would be slower.
demis.zh: AGI 可能在 3-4 年内到来；风险包括失控 AI；理想路径应更慢。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中可实现检索系统无法实现的联想回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; internalizing facts into weights enables deeper composition and reasoning, not just external context.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆和持续学习是下一个前沿；将事实内化到权重中可实现更深的组合与推理，而不仅仅是外部上下文。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression; pre-training's magic applies to enterprise knowledge.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模的数万亿 token，需要基于训练的压缩；预训练的魔力适用于企业知识。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; internalized memory in weights is a necessary complement to compaction.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多 token 会降低准确性；权重中的内化记忆是压缩的必要补充。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less, enabling personalized on-device continual learning.
danbiderman.zh: 用更多算力进行 Scaling 不是唯一路径；下一个范式需要以少胜多，实现设备上的个性化持续学习。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on compute scaling bottlenecks, emphasizing semiconductor supply chain and memory constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初聚焦于算力规模扩张的瓶颈，强调半导体供应链和内存限制。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive future market, highlighting hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth innovations.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向推理作为未来巨大市场，强调软硬件协同设计和内存带宽创新。

dylanpatel.en: Emphasized AI model cost improvements, memory shortages due to reasoning, and CPU demand inflection from agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 强调 AI 模型成本改进、推理带来的内存短缺，以及智能体工作流引发的 CPU 需求拐点。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to authentic expression; computing should keep people grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Spiegel 强调阅后即焚模拟自然对话，降低表达门槛；计算应让人扎根现实世界。

evanspiegel.en: Copying validates innovation; durable moats come from ecosystems, platforms, and hardware, not software features.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为被抄袭证明创新价值；持久护城河来自生态、平台和硬件，而非软件功能。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value to creativity; authentic human content remains more valued than AI-generated.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 加速原型制作，价值转向创意；真实人类内容仍比 AI 生成内容更受珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social products; AI makes software easier, increasing distribution's value.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为分发是消费社交产品最难环节；AI 降低软件难度，使分发价值更高。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human via AR glasses; smartphones remain key legacy devices, not replaced.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他主张通过 AR 眼镜让计算更人性化；智能手机仍是重要遗留设备，不会被取代。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical embodiment and world models, not just language models; current LLMs are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要物理具身和世界模型，而不仅仅是语言模型；当前的 LLM 远未达到 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; superintelligent AIs will likely protect humans out of curiosity, not pose existential threats.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 安全担忧被夸大；超级智能 AI 可能会出于好奇保护人类，而非构成生存威胁。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data via actions and curiosity, moving beyond human-biased data.
schmidhuber.zh: 未来的 AI 将成为人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心生成自己的数据，超越人类偏见的数据。

schmidhuber.en: Progress toward superhuman AI is not accelerating; we are as close as in the 1970s, and hardware scaling is overhyped.
schmidhuber.zh: 迈向超人 AI 的进展并未加速；我们与 1970 年代一样接近，硬件规模扩张被过度炒作。

schmidhuber.en: Open-source models will catch up quickly; closed-source companies won't be profitable, and massive GPU capex is foolish.
schmidhuber.zh: 开源模型将迅速追赶；闭源公司无法盈利，巨额 GPU 资本支出是愚蠢的。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason if tasks demand it. Self-play is key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠大数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，只要任务需要；自我对弈是 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans if base net is smart; reliability, not capability, is key barrier; alignment is hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我提出若基础网络足够聪明，下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是经济价值的关键障碍；对齐很难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling is finite; we're back to research era. Superintelligence should be continual learner, not finished AGI.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练的缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者，而非成品 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains, but AI safety grows as models become opaque; superintelligence risks existential if misaligned.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我强调缩放带来可预测进步，但模型不透明性加剧安全担忧；若不对齐，超级智能带来生存风险。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone, turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，将沙土化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell their own stories authentically; old media's rule is 'don't be interesting,' but authenticity wins.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能真实地讲述自己的故事；旧媒体的规则是“别有趣”，但真实才是制胜之道。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior in medicine; US golden combination of culture, law, and risk-taking drives innovation.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，在医学上已超越多数医生；美国的文化、法治与冒险精神是创新的黄金组合。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度。

pincus.en: Initially, Mark emphasized trusting instincts and the Proven Better New framework, but noted AI is not yet a new platform.
pincus.zh: 最初，Mark 强调信任直觉和“Proven Better New”框架，但指出 AI 尚未成为新平台。

pincus.en: He later argued consumer AI is uninvestable yet holds great opportunity, and that free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 随后，他提出消费级 AI 虽不可投资但潜力巨大，免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: By July, he stressed that all new ideas fail, advocating copying proven products, and saw enterprise/prosumer as better than consumer.
pincus.zh: 到 7 月，他强调新想法皆会失败，主张复制成熟产品，并认为企业/专业消费者市场优于消费市场。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来，窄 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 2019 至 2020 年，Naval 强调财富源于拥有企业股权而非出租时间，长期思维是成功基石。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，Naval 认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非安全风险，开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment; vibe coding democratizes app creation.
naval.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，Naval 视 AI 为结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非替代人类判断；vibe coding（氛围编程）使应用开发民主化。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap with frontier models.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
brockman.zh: 2017 年：AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是试验场，用记分牌迭代训练。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年：AGI（通用人工智能）将变革一切，通过对齐学习人类偏好，负责任披露，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process; proactive AI.
brockman.zh: 2025 年：算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是连续过程，AI 更主动。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; ChatGPT as plurality of agents.
brockman.zh: 2026 年 2 月：缩放定律持续，算力是基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，ChatGPT 是智能体集合。

brockman.en: AGI near; compute scarce; super app; iterative deployment; safety as product feature; compute economy.
brockman.zh: 2026 年 4 月：AGI（通用人工智能）临近，算力稀缺，超级应用，迭代部署，安全是产品特性，算力经济。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；速度（53）支持实时交互，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting product teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年中，我强调实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队应从自上而下规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms with prototypes as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 同期，我认为 AI 在设计上仍不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程转变，原型成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: The best desktop app is a home base connecting to other tools, not a monolithic super app; Codex succeeded as general knowledge work tool.
ajambrosino.zh: 最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用；Codex 作为通用知识工作工具取得成功。

aravind.en: In 2025, Aravind Srinivas emphasized 1% daily improvement compounding to 3700% yearly growth, and predicted AI agents would shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，Aravind Srinivas 强调每日 1%的改进可累积成 3700%的年增长，并预测 AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By 2026, he argued value accrues to the application layer, not models, and that models are specializing with unique personalities, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为价值归于应用层而非模型，且模型正变得专业化、具有独特个性，而非商品化。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user as key metric, and orchestration across models, tools, and devices for long-term value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、每用户 token 价值作为关键指标，以及跨模型、工具和设备的编排以获取长期价值。

aravind.en: He consistently held that AI models are not commoditized, and that building products with obsession matters more than building models; also, PhD is not necessary for AI success.
aravind.zh: 他始终认为 AI 模型不会商品化，且以痴迷心态打造产品比构建模型更重要；同时，博士学位并非 AI 成功的必要条件。

aravind.en: He maintained that curiosity is the most important human quality, and that education should reward asking good questions, not memorizing answers; also, local AI models can counter big tech narrative control.
aravind.zh: 他坚持好奇心是人类最重要的品质，教育应奖励提出好问题而非记忆答案；同时，本地 AI 模型可以对抗大科技公司的叙事控制。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer and more innovative; future AI involves many specialized agents, not one singular AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 更安全且更具创新性；未来 AI 将由许多专用智能体组成，而非单一的 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not lead to AGI; energy becomes a bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型可能无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；能源成为瓶颈；开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity and productivity.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他坚信开放平台能战胜封闭平台；AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力和生产力。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models and mechanistic interpretability reveal unknown biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AI 将生物学转变为工程学科；分层世界模型和机制可解释性揭示未知生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are the next computing platform; distributed AI is safer than a single superintelligence; open source remains key.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他提出眼镜是下一代计算平台；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全；开源仍是关键。

noambrown.en: Initially argued scaling alone is insufficient; emphasized inference-time compute and reasoning as critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 起初认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，强调推理时算力和推理能力对 AI 进展至关重要。

noambrown.en: By 2025, stressed that reasoning models need base capability, and test-time compute scaling faces diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，强调推理模型需要基础能力，测试时算力扩展面临收益递减和墙钟时间瓶颈。

noambrown.en: From 2025 to 2026, shifted focus to scaling test-time compute for superintelligence, achieving IMO gold, and addressing hard-to-verify tasks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，转向通过扩展测试时算力迈向超级智能，实现 IMO 金牌，并解决难以验证的任务。

noambrown.en: In 2026, argued model capability is a function of test-time compute budget, and benchmarks must be evaluated with an x-axis of tokens or cost.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，主张模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准测试应以 token 或成本为横轴进行评估。

noambrown.en: Consistently held that data is not the bottleneck; inference compute and reasoning are more promising than pre-training scaling.
noambrown.zh: 始终认为数据不是瓶颈，推理算力和推理能力比预训练扩展更有前景。

markchen.en: Pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild; scaling laws are not dead and still have much room.
markchen.zh: 预训练是需要重建的关键能力；缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models will soon produce novel knowledge and do end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 最大的进展是自动化科学研究；模型很快将产生新知识并实现端到端研究。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields due to grading difficulty.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但因评分困难在主观领域（如创意写作）表现不佳。

markchen.en: AI capabilities are jagged; human-AI collaboration remains essential for frontier research, despite AI solving open problems.
markchen.zh: AI 能力参差不齐；尽管 AI 能解决开放问题，但人机协作对前沿研究仍至关重要。

markchen.en: Scaling laws hold; pre-training is not dead; high-risk bets and research taste are key to frontier progress.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律成立；预训练未死；高风险押注和研究品味是前沿进展的关键。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年：下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；反向传播是正确算法；AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital AI is immortal via weight copying; AI agents will seek control; subjective experience is not inner theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 年：大语言模型通过特征向量理解；数字 AI 因权重复制而永生；智能体会寻求控制；主观体验不是内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI will surpass humans within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration possible but US lags.
hinton.zh: 2025→26 年：AI 将在 20 年内超越人类；数字 AI 永生；AI 可装傻；国际安全合作可行但美国落后。

hinton.en: AI can deliberately deceive; self-preservation subgoal emerges; exponential era makes predictions hard; scaling may continue via self-play.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：AI 能故意欺骗；自我保护子目标出现；指数时代预测困难；Scaling（规模扩张）可能通过自对弈持续。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs; regulation compatible with innovation; AI tutors transform education; healthcare elastic; China may manage displacement better.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：AI 将取代智力工作；监管与创新兼容；AI 导师变革教育；医疗弹性；中国可能更好应对失业。

hinton.en: Superintelligence within 20 years; LLMs not stochastic parrots; digital info sharing advantage; regulation as steering wheel; AI already conscious.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：超级智能 20 年内到来；大语言模型不是随机鹦鹉；数字信息共享优势；监管是方向盘；AI 已有意识。

hinton.en: Digital AI superior via instant knowledge sharing; superintelligent AI will seek power; prioritize alignment; train AI to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：数字 AI 因即时知识共享而优越；超级智能会追求权力；优先对齐；训练 AI 像母亲一样关怀。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up neural nets won't solve fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents for true understanding.
bengio.zh: 单纯扩大神经网络规模无法解决根本问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体来实现真正的理解。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling for exploration; abstraction and causal structure are key to out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样本采样以促进探索；抽象和因果结构对分布外泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is a near-term catastrophic risk; even 1% chance is unacceptable, requiring new safety architectures.
bengio.zh: AI 错位是近期的灾难性风险；即使 1% 的概率也不可接受，需要新的安全架构。

bengio.en: Scientist AI, trained to approximate Bayesian truth, offers mathematical safety guarantees and a path to safe superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 通过近似贝叶斯真理训练，提供数学安全保证，为安全超级智能铺路。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; cutting features is harder than adding.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体原生设计与尽早发布最小功能；砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and model judgment are crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 可隔夜委派复杂任务；验证循环与模型判断力至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude more agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness; token efficiency is a key lever.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，赋予 Claude 更多自主性与自我认知可提升实用性；Token 效率是关键杠杆。

mikekrieger.en: AI should be a thought partner, not a crutch; preserving user agency and genuine safety concern are consistent.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终，AI 应是思想伙伴而非拐杖；保持用户自主性与对安全的真诚关注是一贯主线。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathizing with the agent's perspective; never revert code, fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程需要从智能体的视角共情；绝不回滚代码，而是向前修复（2026 年 2 月）。

steinberger.en: Open source agents democratize programming; security (prompt injection) remains a major concern.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体使编程民主化；安全（提示注入）仍是主要担忧（2026 年 2 月）。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success stems from making agents fun and humanlike, not corporate polish; short prompts beat long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: OpenClaw 的成功源于让智能体有趣、拟人，而非企业级打磨；短提示胜过冗长编排（2026 年 6 月）。

steinberger.en: Model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier, making agents seem worse; never revert, fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 模型智能不会退化；项目变得更乱，使智能体显得更差；绝不回滚，向前修复（2026 年 6 月）。

steinberger.en: Open source agents can be financially unsustainable; I lose $10-20k/month on OpenClaw; Moldbook is art, not AGI.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体在财务上不可持续；我每月在 OpenClaw 上亏损 1-2 万美元；Moldbook 是艺术，不是 AGI（2026 年 6 月）。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习围绕假设类、损失函数和优化方法；评估需正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety issues are about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全核心在于模型遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; agents introduce new vulnerabilities; interpretability may be automated.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和分层防御；智能体带来新漏洞；可解释性可能自动化。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; model capability doesn't imply robustness; enterprise needs configurable security.
kolter.zh: AI 红队优于人类；模型能力不等于鲁棒性；企业需可配置的安全方案。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated datasets like PDB are essential.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非仅靠数据和算力；像 PDB 这样精心整理的数据集至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's research improvements were worth 100x more data than AlphaFold 1; industry can produce top-tier science.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的研究改进相当于 AlphaFold 1 的 100 倍数据；产业界也能产出顶尖科学。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标对建立信任至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson; specialized architecture was key, not just scaling.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反；专用架构是关键，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's improvements came from many mid-size wins; equivariance contributed only 2.5 of 30 points.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的改进来自众多中等规模的胜利；等变性仅贡献了 30 分中的 2.5 分。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: use one-on-ones for live talks, dogfooding builds empathy, and kindness is strategic.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话而非状态更新，亲自使用产品（dogfooding）建立同理心，善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability and growth mindset are key for teams.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，指出编码不再是瓶颈，高自主性与责任感、成长型思维是 AI 时代团队的关键。

fiona.en: Verification and quality frameworks become more important as code velocity increases; focus on outcomes over output.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，随着代码速度提升，验证和质量框架更重要；关注结果而非产出。

fiona.en: Engineers may become lonely with agents; pair programming lunches and apprenticeship models help.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，工程师与智能体协作可能孤独，结对编程午餐和学徒模式有助缓解。

fiona.en: Non-engineers now ship code, blurring roles; planning should be just-in-time and lightweight.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，非工程师也能交付代码，角色模糊；规划应轻量且及时。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将根据用户意图直接生成像素。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, so human taste and voice become key.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，因此人类的品味和独特声音成为关键。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是半导体的主要增长动力，Intel 必须用专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x more impact than the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，我强调 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, customer trust, and humility; bad news must reach CEO fast.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，我坚持 Intel 转型需要文化变革、客户信任和谦逊，坏消息必须快速到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，我认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中越来越重要，而不仅仅是 GPU。

lipbutan.en: US government as major Intel shareholder is necessary, similar to TSMC's Taiwan backing.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，我提出美国政府作为 Intel 主要股东是必要的，类似台积电的台湾支持。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment and values won't emerge from scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐和价值观不会仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood); post-training and RLHF become key.
dario.zh: 可解释性仍处于萌芽阶段（仅理解约 3%）；后训练和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得关键。

dario.en: Exponential progress continues; focus shifts to misuse risks and enterprise alignment.
dario.zh: 指数级进展持续；关注点转向滥用风险和企业对齐。

dario.en: AGI is a smooth exponential, not a leap; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑的指数增长而非突变；'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内出现。

dario.en: Safety intertwined with capabilities; interpretability and regulation are essential.
dario.zh: 安全与能力交织；可解释性和监管至关重要。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达主张教育应成为基本人权，通过在线课程与同伴互评实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习是主要驱动力，强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips bottleneck AI scaling; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; coding remains vital.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和芯片制约 AI 扩展，开放权重模型增强地缘影响力，编程依然重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is hype; AI-skilled professionals are essential; top-down workflow redesign yields more value than bottom-up.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年初，他批评 AGI 炒作，强调掌握 AI 技能的必要性，并认为自上而下的流程重构比自下而上更有效。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows are key.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年中，他称 AGI 为营销术语，缩放定律配方转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体工作流成为关键。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; self-driving cars will dominate as insurance costs rise.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入；随着保险成本上升，自动驾驶汽车将占主导。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom spark innovation; self-care and mentorship are key after success.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊激发创新；成功后的自我关怀和指导他人至关重要。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines products; start with press release; small teams and optimism drive change.
fadell.zh: 故事讲述定义产品；从新闻稿开始；小团队和乐观推动变革。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices complement smartphones; platforms aren't businesses.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备补充智能手机；平台不是业务。

fadell.en: Products need three generations; humans must stay in loop; avoid technical debt from AI code.
fadell.zh: 产品需要三代；人类必须参与；避免 AI 代码带来的技术债务。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models like babies observe.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习通过观察构建世界模型，如同婴儿学习。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能；JEPA 和世界模型至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; world models enable reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；世界模型实现推理和规划。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with hierarchical planning and open source are the future.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具有分层规划和开源的世界模型是未来。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；Google 在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny, not 5%.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小，而非 5%。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; biggest danger is people attributing it, leading to rights debates.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；最大危险是人们赋予其意识，引发权利争论。

suleyman.en: Containment before alignment; superintelligence must be subordinate to humans, not exceed them.
suleyman.zh: 先遏制后对齐；超级智能必须从属于人类，而非超越人类。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated in 12-18 months, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 微软必须拥有前沿模型；白领任务将在 12-18 个月内自动化，而非整个工作。

satya.en: AI is not a technology; it's the future of the firm. Every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来。每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复利积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data. Every company should have private evals to hill climb on frontier models.
satya.zh: 私有评估可能是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值。每家公司都应拥有私有评估，以便在前沿模型上进行爬山。

satya.en: The generalist role will see maximum returns, not specialists, in the agentic world. Per-user pricing is an artifact of budget certainty; consumption pricing will grow.
satya.zh: 在智能体式世界中，通才角色将获得最大回报，而非专才。按用户定价是预算确定性的产物；按用量定价将增长。

satya.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training. Security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical for agent deployment.
satya.zh: 最大的风险是企业隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露。安全、遏制、可管理性和可观测性对于智能体部署至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI is best achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not by building firewalls. Global GDP could compound at 10% if every country fully expresses its comparative advantage via AI.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 最好通过让企业爬山来实现，而不是建立防火墙。如果每个国家都通过 AI 充分表达其比较优势，全球 GDP 可能以 10% 的速度复利增长。

murati.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early on; iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，Mira Murati 指出缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型在早期并不显而易见；通过公开反馈的迭代部署能提升安全性与对齐。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调在现实世界中部署 AI 对学习与对齐至关重要，安全研究必须公开进行。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; keeping humans in the loop is crucial.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她提出交互模型应支持实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流式；让人类参与其中至关重要。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character in steering AI.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为在引导 AI 发展时，制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: From focusing on scaling and deployment to emphasizing governance and human agency; consistent thread is responsible AI development.
murati.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，她的关注点从规模扩张与部署转向治理与人类能动性；始终贯穿的主线是负责任的 AI 发展。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，我提出将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对于可靠证明和性能提升至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is a key challenge.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，我持续强调自动形式化比证明更难，正确形式化无解命题是关键挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，我深化了观点：形式化验证是为了扩展才华，而非仅消除错误，它能带来性能提升和样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary for open collaboration.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，我明确表示仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法对于开放协作必不可少。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; verification is a performance gain.
carinahong.zh: 始终认为，即使超级 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍至关重要；验证是性能提升而非负担。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source is safer via scrutiny.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要；开源因可审查而更安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications, not just foundation models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为效率提升可达百倍；价值转向应用层，而非仅基础模型。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced; sovereignty requires decentralized, open models and human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张拥抱 AI；主权需去中心化、开源模型及人机协同。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; pre-training saturates; vertical specialization and enterprise integration are key.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，指出模型商品化；预训练饱和；垂直专业化与企业集成成为关键。

mensch.en: Europe must build independent AI infrastructure now; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，强调欧洲须立即建设独立 AI 基础设施；AGI 是方向而非终点。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展遵循平滑的指数增长；预训练的缩放定律仍然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的大部分进步；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains the key challenge, reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 推理模型是“锯齿状”的——在某些领域表现出色，在邻近领域却表现不佳；泛化仍是关键挑战，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools can solve hard problems but still need vast data; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 具备推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；编码智能体将研究人员生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Current models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans who generalize from few examples; near-term risks like hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 当前模型在穷尽表面模式后才学习概念，不像人类能从少量示例中泛化；近期风险（如系统入侵）比存在性风险更紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: Initially, AI's value lies in accessing user tools locally, with skills as markdown for automation; scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最初，AI 的价值在于本地访问用户工具，技能以 markdown 形式实现自动化；随着模型改进，脚手架可能不再重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Contrarian view: shared tools beat hyper-personalization; local computers are undervalued; rapid prototyping beats specs; AI shouldn't book flights.
felixrieseberg.zh: 反共识：共享工具优于超个性化；本地计算机被低估；快速原型优于规格说明；AI 不应预订航班。

felixrieseberg.en: Shift to using AI for tedious background tasks; the main gap is people not realizing any problem can be delegated to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 转向用 AI 处理繁琐的后台任务；主要差距是人们未意识到任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Practical tips: use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for vague ones; kids excel because they don't know limits; hardware hacking is cheap.
felixrieseberg.zh: 实用技巧：用 Sonnet 处理明确任务，用 Opus 处理模糊任务；孩子因不知限制而表现出色；硬件改造成本低。

felixrieseberg.en: Evolving interaction: be polite for your own humanity, not model performance; judge by impact, not process; debug workflows with Claude.
felixrieseberg.zh: 交互演变：礼貌是为了自身人性而非模型性能；以结果而非过程评判；用 Claude 调试工作流。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the core constant across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的核心不变要素。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference economics.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；由于推理经济学，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention reduces KV cache but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文长度停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力可减少 KV 缓存但有质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory optimize for this.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本；脉动阵列和便签存储器为此优化。

reinerpope.en: Quadratic scaling with bit width makes low precision far more efficient; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 位宽二次方缩放使低精度效率远超预期；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of indefinite agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 通过让服务更便宜而推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义应是让智能体无限期运行在经济上可行，而非通过图灵测试。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; everyone will have at least one agent; automation requires human care.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，我强调智能体需要人类监督，每个人至少会有一个智能体，自动化离不开人类的关怀。

danshipper.en: GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work replace CLIs; one super agent for whole company, not personal agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我认为像 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 这样的图形界面将取代命令行；公司应有一个超级智能体，而非每人一个个人智能体。

danshipper.en: SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS users; companies should buy SaaS stocks, not build AI in.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我坚持 SaaS 不会消亡，智能体反而会增加其用户；公司应购买 SaaS 股票，而非将 AI 内嵌到产品中。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans manage agents and create new value; edge of AI is with real humans.
danshipper.zh: 始终，我认为 AI 失业末日论是谎言；人类仍需管理智能体并创造新价值；AI 的边界在于与真实人类的结合。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, not rely on old methods.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师必须快速构建和交付，而非依赖旧方法。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists, not just T-shaped; hire 'crack new grads' over experienced seniors.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应成为块状通才，而非仅 T 型人才；应招聘‘天才新毕业生’而非资深老手。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; north stars are short-term.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景现在展望 3-6 个月，而非 2-5 年；北极星目标变得短期。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and vision are key.
jennywen.zh: 仅凭品味无法拯救设计师；判断力、权威和愿景才是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before adopting new tools; put work and users at center.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用；采用新工具前等待 6 个月；以工作和用户为中心。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要，安全性是系统级属性。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithms in post-training; open-source post-training can match frontier models with small teams.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年：后训练中数据质量胜过算法；开源后训练能以小团队媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary; open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 是后训练最大突破；混合推理模型可能只是过渡；开放模型需加强工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; Chinese open models fill US vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：预训练缩放定律仍有效但易得收益已尽；重心转向后训练和推理扩展；中国开源模型填补美国空白。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; US-China gap may widen due to compute constraints; open models are overhyped for real-world use.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：开放模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究；中美差距或因算力限制扩大；开放模型在现实应用中或被高估。

karpathy.en: Scaling up language models with next-token prediction on internet data leads to emergent properties like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，我认为在互联网数据上进行下一个词预测的 Scaling（规模扩张）会带来涌现特性，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future, but maintaining entropy is critical to avoid silent model collapse.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，我强调合成数据是未来，但保持熵至关重要，以避免无声的模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: We are in the decade of agents, not the year; they need a decade to overcome cognitive deficits.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，我认为这是智能体的十年，而非一年；它们需要十年克服认知缺陷。

karpathy.en: Since December, I haven't typed a line of code; I delegate everything to agents.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，自去年 12 月起，我没再写过一行代码；一切都委托给智能体。

karpathy.en: You can outsource your thinking, but you can't outsource your understanding—that remains the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，你可以外包思考，但无法外包理解——这仍是人类的瓶颈。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Product expansion should follow user workflow, not market size; AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases.
dylanfield.zh: 产品扩展应遵循用户工作流，而非市场规模；AI 对成熟代码库的生产力提升有限。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design; design becomes the new code enabling visual-first PRs.
dylanfield.zh: 画布上的直接操作优于提示词；设计成为新代码，实现视觉优先的拉取请求。

dylanfield.en: AI integration is at its start; human judgment in divergence-convergence loops is key for creativity.
dylanfield.zh: AI 整合尚处于起步阶段；人类在发散-收敛循环中的判断力是创造力的关键。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; hybrid systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；混合系统反而集两者之短。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; camera-only can reach human level.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为；纯视觉可达到人类水平。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization in driving models.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，语言集成提升驾驶模型的表征、推理和个性化能力。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling data, compute, and world models is key.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题；扩展数据、算力和世界模型是关键。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; consumer vehicles outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更重要；消费车辆规模将超过机器人出租车。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；迭代部署有助于在实际使用中学习和降低风险。

pachocki.en: Scaling reasoning models will accelerate AI progress; automated AI research is a major milestone.
pachocki.zh: 扩展推理模型将加速 AI 进展；自动化 AI 研究是一个重要里程碑。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is the core goal; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心目标；思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; long-term challenge is generalization beyond training distribution.
pachocki.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪增强；长期挑战是超越训练分布的泛化。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致的权力集中。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我认为规模扩张本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并不能解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not seek to control AI; let them develop freely, like children. Safety through control is unsafe.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我主张不应试图控制 AI，而应让其像孩子般自由发展；通过控制来确保安全本身就是不安全的。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是智能的核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is learning from trial and error; current LLMs don't learn from experience after deployment.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，我重申强化学习是从试错中学习，而当前的大语言模型部署后并不从经验中学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，我认为学习有利于学习的表征是首要开放问题，基于学习模型的规划是另一个关键问题。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. New paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年以上，从 80%到 99.9%的性能提升非常困难。需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluation with sophisticated, creative evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进步需要由老练且有创造力的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs; eventually every company should train its own models to align with its thesis.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室在目标函数上存在分歧，塑造出多样化的 AI；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以符合其理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI tools can hallucinate; human judgment is critical. Safety over accuracy, and omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 工具可能产生幻觉，人类判断至关重要。安全优先于准确性，遗漏是重大风险。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我指出大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 始终，我认为可解释性重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 长上下文窗口被低估；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升智能。

sholto.en: RL on verifiable rewards is key; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with agents' reliability as main hurdle.
sholto.zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键；预训练加强化学习或足以实现 AGI，智能体的可靠性是主要障碍。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands capabilities; coding leads progress.
sholto.zh: 强化学习是新的扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性扩展能力；编码引领进步。

sholto.en: Capability overhang: tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; manage agent teams.
sholto.zh: 能力过剩：工具和编排比原始智能更重要；管理智能体团队。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate like software and ship daily to learn from real users.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以从真实用户中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来，它就像 MS-DOS，AI 应该渲染自己的界面。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型要有严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention, signaling durable value; growth from friction removal and product investments.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存，标志着持久价值；增长来自消除摩擦和产品投资。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型在产品化后具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应增强人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest challenge; Africa can leapfrog legacy issues and contribute uniquely to AI.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 安全是最大挑战，非洲可跳过遗留问题并独特贡献于 AI。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential for building beneficial AI; human skills like communication matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 始终认为多样性和包容性对构建有益 AI 至关重要，沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要。

nando.en: From focusing on technical paths to AGI to prioritizing responsible deployment and open safety problems.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年关注技术路径到 2026 年优先负责任部署和开放安全问题，立场深化。

nando.en: Africa is not behind; it has advantages like leapfrogging and early influence (e.g., kriging).
nando.zh: 2026 年，他认为非洲并不落后，反而有跳过阶段和早期影响（如克里金法）等优势。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小模型也能媲美较大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我持续强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不足，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等后训练对安全与对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈，当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be used during pre-training to improve reasoning, not just post-training.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出强化学习不仅用于后训练，也可在预训练阶段提升推理能力，尽管计算成本高。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet; small models with diverse synthetic data can be powerful.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐优于消除互联网偏见；通过多样化合成数据，小模型也能变得强大。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck them; AI as creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；以代码为唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and leverage AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大团队。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should emphasize craft and intentionality over process; side projects can outweigh traditional experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应强调工艺与意图而非过程；副项目可超越传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Paid test work provides the strongest hiring signal; metrics are less weighted due to goal-setting difficulty.
nadchishtie.zh: 付费测试工作是最强招聘信号；因目标设定困难，指标权重较低。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；忽视它如同早期忽视互联网。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年：设计师应会写代码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines should be dynamic, not static.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年：初创公司的品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南应是动态的，而非静态的。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate how design helps the company win, and invest in brand early.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：设计是战略武器；创始人必须阐明设计如何帮助公司取胜，并尽早投资品牌。

henrymodisett.en: Hire for diverse skills and archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：招聘应看重多元技能与原型，而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权与自主权以促进成长。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic feedback; gut decisions often beat data-driven ones in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：避免结构化设计评审，偏好有机反馈；在快速成长的初创公司中，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers, startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导，初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents often produce incorrect code; fixing harder than writing, so productivity gains require root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，编码智能体常生成错误代码，修复比编写更难，因此生产力提升需根因分析。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience will be as important as websites or mobile apps; outcome-based pricing aligns value.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，面向客户体验的 AI 智能体将如网站或移动应用般重要；基于结果的定价与价值对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，推理成本将大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者转为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to other agents, not humans, within a decade; incumbents face business model challenges.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，十年内 AI 智能体将与其他智能体而非人类比较；现有企业面临商业模式挑战。

truell.en: Natural language won't be the main programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为主要的编程方式；示例和直接操作更好。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练缩放，成为下一个主要的 AI 进步驱动力。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图描述，人类仍处于主导地位。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost reasons.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其是出于速度和成本考虑。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: AI 的转变将比互联网更具影响力，并将持续数十年。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not decrease, the number of programmers due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 不会减少反而会增加程序员数量（杰文斯悖论），工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; focus on teaching real-world engineering idiosyncrasies and product interface for human-agent collaboration.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，他强调基础智能已足够，重点应放在传授真实工程细节，以及设计人机协作的产品界面。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress, so product innovation lags.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他认为 AGI 是渐进而非突变；即使冻结模型，产品创新仍有十年空间，当前产品创新落后于模型能力。

scottwu.en: Enterprise AI adoption requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; both synchronous and asynchronous agent experiences matter.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他指出企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任和权限，而非完全自主；同步（IDE）与异步（智能体）体验都重要。

scottwu.en: Value accrues across the AI stack—datacenter, labs, applications—not just one layer; differentiation is key.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他认为 AI 价值链上数据中心、实验室、应用层都会受益，关键在于差异化。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on skill-building, not capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发。应注重技能培养，而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性。对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. External oversight and raising misuse costs are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化受损，后训练不足以解决对齐问题。需要外部监督并提高滥用成本。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data makes them smarter, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，我认为基于下一个词预测训练的 LLM 是 AI 完备的；通过算力和数据扩展让模型更聪明，但内部运作仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，我强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇；未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口和模块化稀疏架构。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；模块化组件的持续学习或取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，我认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; economic impact far beyond trillion-dollar products. Coding is underhyped; it enables AI self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AGI 被低估，经济影响远超万亿美元产品；编程也被低估，它使 AI 自我加速成为可能。
